subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
title: Islamic Manners of Dressing
overview: Clothes are a gift from Allah (S.W.T.). Islam teaches Muslims how to dress so that the body is covered, clean and decent. In this sub-strand you will learn the features of the Islamic code of dressing, why it is important for good character, and the manners Muslims follow when dressing so that they earn rewards from Allah.

lessons.title: Features of the Islamic code of dressing
objectives: State the features of the Islamic code of dressing.
Name the part of the body (awrah) that boys and girls must cover.
Name some Islamic attires worn in Kenya.
lessons.intro: On Friday many Muslim boys go to the mosque in a clean white kanzu and a kofia, and girls wear a hijab or a buibui. Why do Muslims dress this way? The Qur’an and the Sunnah give the answer.
lessons.notes:
### Clothing is a gift from Allah
Allah (S.W.T.) says: “O children of Adam, We have sent down to you clothing to cover your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness is the best.” (Qur’an 7:26)

This verse teaches that clothes have two uses: to cover the body and to make us look good. It also teaches that the best clothing is taqwa, which means fearing Allah and doing what is right.

### Awrah: the parts of the body that must be covered
Awrah is the part of the body that a Muslim must cover in front of other people.

- For a boy or a man, the awrah is from the navel to the knees.
- For a girl or a woman in front of men who are not close family, most scholars teach that the awrah is the whole body except the face and the hands.

### Features of Islamic dress
- It covers the awrah.
- It is loose, not tight, so that the shape of the body is not shown.
- It is thick, not see-through.
- It is clean and neat.
- Men’s clothes are different from women’s clothes. The Prophet (S.A.W) cursed men who imitate women and women who imitate men (Bukhari).
- It is not worn to show off. Men should not wear silk or gold.
- It does not carry bad words or pictures.

### Islamic attires in Kenya
- Boys and men: kanzu, kofia (cap), and long trousers with a shirt.
- Girls and women: hijab (head covering), buibui or jilbab (a loose outer garment), a long dress or skirt with long sleeves.

In school, Muslim girls may wear a hijab and long skirt or trousers in the school colours, and boys wear long trousers when they can.

keyWords.meaning: the parts of the body a Muslim must cover in front of other people
a head covering worn by Muslim girls and women; also the Islamic way of covering
a long, loose robe worn by Muslim boys and men
fear of Allah that makes a person do right and avoid wrong

examples.problem: Fatuma has a tight, see-through blouse and a loose, thick long dress. Which one meets the Islamic code of dressing?
steps: Islamic dress must be loose and not see-through.
The tight blouse shows the shape of the body and can be seen through.

activity.title: Islamic attires chart
materials: Pictures, charts or a video clip of Islamic attires
steps: Watch a video clip or look at pictures of different Islamic attires.
In groups, name each attire and say who wears it.
Draw a boy and a girl in Islamic dress and label the attires.
Under the drawing, list three features of the Islamic code of dressing.

practice.question: What is the awrah of a boy?
practice.answer: From the navel to the knees.

practice.question: State three features of the Islamic code of dressing.
practice.answer: Any three: covers the awrah; loose; not see-through; clean; men and women dress differently; not for showing off; no bad words or pictures.

practice.question: Name two Islamic attires worn by Muslim girls in Kenya.
practice.answer: Any two: hijab, buibui, jilbab, long dress.

practice.question: According to Qur’an 7:26, what is the best clothing?

summary: Clothes are a gift from Allah to cover the body and to beautify.
Islamic dress covers the awrah, is loose, thick, clean and decent.
Men and women must not imitate each other in dressing.

lessons.title: Why the Islamic code of dressing is important
objectives: Explain how the Islamic code of dressing builds good character.
Identify dressing trends that a Muslim should avoid.
lessons.intro: People often judge us first by how we dress. When a learner comes to school clean, neat and decently dressed, others respect him or her. Islam teaches that decent dressing also pleases Allah.
lessons.notes:
### Importance of the Islamic code of dressing
- It is obedience to Allah. Covering the awrah is a command of Allah, so dressing properly is worship.
- It builds haya (modesty). Haya means feeling shy to do wrong. The Prophet (S.A.W) said that haya is a branch of faith (Bukhari and Muslim).
- It protects a person. Decent dress helps protect boys and girls from bad looks and wrong behaviour. Allah commands believing men and women to lower their gaze and guard their modesty (Qur’an 24:30-31).
- It earns respect. People respect someone who is dressed decently.
- It shows identity. Islamic dress shows that a person is a Muslim who is proud of the faith.
- It keeps us clean and healthy. Clean clothes help prevent disease and bad smell. The Prophet (S.A.W) said, “Allah is beautiful and He loves beauty.” (Muslim)
- It removes pride. A Muslim does not dress to show off, because Allah does not love the proud.

### Dressing trends a Muslim should avoid
- Tight clothes that show the shape of the body
- See-through or very short clothes that do not cover the awrah
- Boys wearing clothes, jewellery or hairstyles meant for girls, and girls dressing like boys
- Clothes with bad words, pictures of drugs or alcohol, or rude pictures
- Trousers pulled down so that underwear shows
- Dirty, torn or smelly clothes when one can wash or mend them
- Very expensive clothes worn only to show off

### Character formation
When a Muslim dresses decently every day, he or she learns self-respect, self-control and obedience to Allah. These are signs of good character (akhlaq).

keyWords.meaning: modesty; feeling shy to do or show what is wrong
a new style that many people copy

examples.problem: Hamisi’s friends tell him to wear a T-shirt with a picture of a beer bottle because it is ‘in fashion’. What should he do and why?
steps: The picture promotes alcohol, which Islam forbids.
A Muslim should not follow a trend that goes against Islamic teachings.
He should politely refuse and wear decent clothes.
examples.answer: He should politely say no, because Islamic dress should not carry pictures or words of forbidden things.

activity.title: Group discussion and presentation
steps: In groups, look at pictures of different styles of dressing.
Sort them into styles that meet the Islamic code and styles to avoid.
Discuss the importance of the Islamic code of dressing and write four points.
Choose one member to present your points to the class, and listen respectfully to other groups.

practice.question: Give three reasons why the Islamic code of dressing is important.
practice.answer: Any three: obedience to Allah; builds modesty (haya); protects a person; earns respect; shows Muslim identity; keeps us clean; removes pride.

practice.question: What is haya?
practice.answer: Modesty, or feeling shy to do or show what is wrong. It is a branch of faith.

practice.question: Name two dressing trends a Muslim should avoid.
practice.answer: Any two: tight clothes, see-through or short clothes, boys dressing like girls or girls like boys, clothes with bad words or pictures, sagging trousers, dressing to show off.

summary: Decent dressing is obedience to Allah and builds haya.
It protects us, earns respect and shows our Muslim identity.
Avoid tight, see-through, indecent or show-off fashions.

lessons.title: Manners of dressing as ibadah
objectives: Practise the Sunnah manners of putting on and taking off clothes.
Model ideal Islamic dress in class.
Explain how proper dressing earns rewards from Allah.
lessons.intro: Every morning you get dressed for school. That simple act can earn you rewards from Allah (S.W.T.) if you follow the manners taught by the Prophet (S.A.W).
lessons.notes:
### Manners of dressing
- Say Bismillah (In the name of Allah) before dressing.
- Start with the right side. The Prophet (S.A.W) liked to begin with the right in putting on his shoes, combing his hair and in all his affairs (Bukhari and Muslim). Put the right arm into the sleeve first and the right foot into the trouser leg or shoe first.
- When taking off clothes and shoes, start with the left.
- Thank Allah for the clothes by saying Alhamdulillah, especially when wearing new clothes.
- Wear clean clothes and keep them neat. Wash, iron and mend them.
- Dress in private, and cover yourself when changing.
- Wear your best clean clothes for Jumu’ah (Friday) prayer and for Eid.
- Do not drag clothes on the ground out of pride. The Prophet (S.A.W) said that Allah will not look on the Day of Judgement at a person who drags his garment out of pride (Bukhari and Muslim).
- Do not waste money buying clothes you do not need; give old clothes that are still good to people in need.

### Dressing as ibadah
Ibadah is any good act done to please Allah. When a Muslim covers the awrah, dresses decently and follows these manners with the intention of obeying Allah, the act of dressing becomes worship. Covering the awrah is also a condition for swalah, so proper dress is needed for prayer.

### Earning rewards
Allah rewards those who obey Him. A Muslim who dresses decently, avoids pride and thanks Allah for clothes earns rewards, is respected by people and pleases Allah. This is why Muslims appreciate the Islamic code of dressing and follow it even when others do not.

keyWords.meaning: the sayings, actions and approvals of the Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W)

examples.problem: Put these steps in the Sunnah order for putting on a shirt: (i) say Alhamdulillah (ii) put in the right arm (iii) say Bismillah (iv) put in the left arm.
steps: Begin with Bismillah.
Start with the right side, then the left.
Thank Allah at the end.

activity.title: Model an ideal Islamic dress
materials: Kanzu, kofia, hijab, buibui or long dress brought from home
steps: Volunteers dress in ideal Islamic attire and walk in front of the class.
The class checks each attire against the features of Islamic dress: covers the awrah, loose, thick and clean.
Demonstrate saying Bismillah and starting with the right side when putting on a jacket or shoes.
Each learner writes one way he or she will improve their own dressing.

practice.question: Which side should a Muslim start with when putting on clothes and shoes?
What should a Muslim say before dressing and after wearing new clothes?
practice.answer: Bismillah before dressing and Alhamdulillah after wearing new clothes.

practice.question: How can getting dressed become an act of ibadah?
practice.answer: When a Muslim dresses decently and follows the Sunnah manners with the intention of obeying Allah.

practice.question: Why is covering the awrah important for swalah?
practice.answer: Covering the awrah is a condition for swalah to be valid.

summary: Say Bismillah, start with the right and thank Allah for clothes.
Keep clothes clean and never dress out of pride.
Dressing to obey Allah is ibadah and earns rewards.

quiz.question: What is the awrah of a Muslim boy?
options: From the navel to the knees
quiz.explanation: A male must cover from the navel to the knees.

quiz.question: Which of these is a feature of Islamic dress?
quiz.explanation: Islamic dress is loose, thick and covers the awrah.

quiz.question: Which attire is worn by Muslim boys and men, especially for Friday prayers?
quiz.explanation: The kanzu is a long loose robe worn by men and boys.

quiz.question: Qur’an 7:26 says the best clothing is …
quiz.explanation: Allah says the clothing of righteousness (taqwa) is best.

quiz.question: What is haya?
quiz.answer: Modesty; feeling shy to do or show what is wrong.
quiz.explanation: The Prophet (S.A.W) said haya is a branch of faith.

quiz.question: Which dressing trend should a Muslim avoid?
options: A T-shirt with a picture of alcohol
quiz.explanation: Clothes should not promote forbidden things like alcohol.

quiz.question: Give two ways in which the Islamic code of dressing helps to build good character.
quiz.answer: Any two: it teaches obedience to Allah, modesty, self-respect, self-control and humility.
quiz.explanation: Decent dressing every day trains a person in good akhlaq.

quiz.question: When putting on shoes, a Muslim should start with the …
quiz.explanation: The Prophet (S.A.W) liked to begin with the right.

quiz.question: What should a Muslim say before dressing?
quiz.explanation: Muslims begin good acts in the name of Allah.

quiz.question: Why does the Prophet (S.A.W) warn against dragging clothes on the ground out of pride?
quiz.answer: Because Allah will not look on the Day of Judgement at a person who does so out of pride.
quiz.explanation: Pride is disliked by Allah; Muslims dress humbly.

quiz.question: How does following the Islamic code of dressing help a Muslim?
options: It is a waste of time
quiz.explanation: Obeying Allah’s command on dressing earns rewards.
